newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-INTERPOOL Q2 NET INCOME DECLINES. [CORRECTED 22:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: TABLE-INTERPOOL Q2 NET INCOME DECLINES. [CORRECTED 22:45 GMT]

text.p: THREE MONTHS ENDED SIX MONTHS ENDED
NOTE: -- (1) Revenues in the second quarter of 1997 includes $1.5 million of successful legal claim recovery.

-- (2) Represents a non-cash and non-recurring charge for accumulated dividends of its subsidiary, Trac Lease, Inc., which resulted from the acquisition of the outstanding preferred stock of Trac Lease Inc through the issuance of Interpool, Inc. preferred stock. Such charge has no impact on net income per share because unpaid dividends were included in the computation of net income per share.

-- (3) Represents a special non-recurring charge to retained earnings during the first quarter of 1997 of $6,716 for the redemption of 5 3/4% Convertible Preferred Stock expressed as amount per share.

-- Company says that in past two weeks it has taken advantage of debt markets attractive levels by issuing $225 million (corrects from $255 million) of ten year notes, comprised of $150 million of 7.35 percent notes due 2007 and $75 million of 7.20 percent notes due 2007. These notes represent company's first issues of unsecured debt.
